messages.author: Adaeze Nkemelu
messages.text: B-12.6.3-arm-r1 was cut from the withdrawn rev 1 — it is superseded and nothing deploys from it. Nodes 10 and 11 are already 12.6.4 from the canary.

messages.author: Wren Haviland
messages.text: Friday's sessions on the data lane are the reconciliation block, and the reindex holds the weekend. Monday night is the first open session.

messages.author: Inês Moraes
messages.text: A deferral past the 21st would be mine to sign, and nobody has asked. The early-access fee is inside Saoirse's approval this time.
